:::{#sol-matmul-assoc-practice}

First,

$$
\ba
\matr{B}\vx
&= \begin{bmatrix} 2 \cd 1 + 0 \cd 2 \\ 1 \cd 1 + 1 \cd 2 \end{bmatrix}
&& \text{(@def-matrix-mult)}
\\
&= \begin{bmatrix} 2 \\ 3 \end{bmatrix},
&& \text{(multiply and add)}
\ea
$$

so

$$
\ba
\matr{A}\matr{B}\vx
&= \matr{A}(\matr{B}\vx)
&& \text{(@thm-matmul-assoc)}
\\
&= \begin{bmatrix} 1 \cd 2 + 1 \cd 3 \\ 0 \cd 2 + 1 \cd 3 \end{bmatrix}
&& \text{(@def-matrix-mult)}
\\
&= \begin{bmatrix} 5 \\ 3 \end{bmatrix}.
&& \text{(multiply and add)}
\ea
$$

Grouping the other way gives the same answer:
$\matr{A}\matr{B} = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$,
and $(\matr{A}\matr{B})\vx = \begin{bmatrix} 3 + 2 \\ 1 + 2 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 5 \\ 3 \end{bmatrix}$.

:::
